algorithm: CA-BOSS v4.55 empirical-null-calibrated bootstrap stability rescue

v455_empirical_null_calibrated_stability.interpretation: edge-specific empirical-null stability floors recover four reproducible W2 proposals rejected by the fixed 0.80 cutoff while abstaining when a calibration null is equally stable

method_contract.proposal_source: nominal v4.54 sign-invariant W2 distribution-geometry proposals only
method_contract.target_candidate_bootstrap: 100 whole-world resamples under the frozen v4.54 nested reciprocal rule
method_contract.null_reference: maximum selection count among every labelled null assay pair in four non-target candidate blocks
method_contract.null_count_estimation: each candidate calibration block is scored in three folds whose null labels exclude both the target and candidate blocks
method_contract.empirical_null_gate: target selection count strictly exceeds the worst non-target null count
method_contract.uncertainty_gate: working Beta(1,1) probability that the target selection probability exceeds the worst-null probability is at least 0.975
method_contract.uncertainty_caveat: bootstrap refits are dependent and are not treated as independent Bernoulli trials; the Beta comparison is a conservative working score, not a calibrated posterior
method_contract.conflict_handling: merge connected assay pairs into one unexpanded ambiguity hyperedge
method_contract.claim_scope: shared-state equivalence only; never within-assay direct structure, exact cross-assay feature identity, or direction

null_calibration_audit.catastrophic_null_interpretation: a null reached frequency 1.0 for these targets, so the strict empirical-null rule correctly admitted no v4.55 additions

published_method_inspiration.unpaired_multi_domain_causal_representat: Sturma, Squires, Drton, and Uhler (NeurIPS 2023), Unpaired Multi-Domain Causal Representation Learning, DOI 10.52202/075280-1496
published_method_inspiration.mmd_ma: Liu, Huang, Singh, Vert, and Noble (WABI 2019), Jointly Embedding Multiple Single-Cell Omics Measurements, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.WABI.2019.10
published_method_inspiration.scot: Demetci, Santorella, Sandstede, Noble, and Singh (Journal of Computational Biology 2022), SCOT: Single-Cell Multi-Omics Alignment with Optimal Transport, DOI 10.1089/cmb.2021.0446
published_method_inspiration.stability_selection: Meinshausen and Buehlmann (JRSS B 2010), Stability Selection, DOI 10.1111/j.1467-9868.2010.00740.x
published_method_inspiration.relationship: V4.55 combines distributional latent-component matching with target-separated empirical-null stability calibration. No publication contributes data, correspondence, modality identity, feature identity, biological priors, or an identifiability guarantee for this simulator.

limitations.interpretation: V4.55 is the strongest conservative cached-world checkpoint, but all 103 worlds informed method development. Its 1.0 retrospective precision does not establish out-of-sample completeness or identify direct cross-assay effects from disjoint cells.
